'''Sor Venge''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]]. Around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he led a contingent of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] during the search for a group of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] and a [[Holocron/Legends|Holocron]] at the [[Well of Shadows]].

He wore dark [[Robe/Legends|robes]] and wielded a [[crimson]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].

==Behind the scenes==
Sor Venge appears in the introductory story for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2016]] [[roleplaying game]] book [[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]].
